units.source_text: 那是一块无比巨大的岩石，下面是万丈深渊，

en.t: It was an enormous boulder, with a bottomless abyss below,

units.source_text: 这里的地势想必非常的高，北斗星遥挂天上，

en.t: The ground here must have been extremely high, for the Big Dipper hung far away in the sky,

units.source_text: 星光璀璨，看上去竟然和茶碗的大小差不多。

en.t: its starlight glittered so brightly that it seemed almost as large as a tea bowl.

units.source_text: 这里本是人迹罕至的深山，四周寂静无声，

en.t: This was deep in the mountains, where people rarely came, and everything around was silent,

units.source_text: 耳朵里能听到的声音，也只有身后绝壁上生长着的一棵虬曲老松在夜风中呼呼颤动的声音。

en.t: the only sound to be heard was the old twisted pine growing on the sheer cliff behind him, shuddering and roaring in the night wind.
